reviews.review:
I read an interview with the developer of this game before purchasing it. Apparently it's their first effort and I think with some more experience the positive qualities this game has could be turned into something good.

Unfortunately, Sanity Break amounts to a Slender/Lethal Company clone with neither the atmosphere to sustain a single-player horror experience and none of the goofing off with friends that might have made this work in the absence of genuine scares. Gameplay amounts to walking around as a severely short-sighted abductee in a suit while you are assailed and stalked by:

- Pup Pups: marionettes that instakill you on contact and can only be seen through the video camera which strangely also seems to suffer from myopia.
- Slips: a low res JPEG that screams at you and then instakills you on contact
- Mimics: as far as I can tell they just pickpocket you for 700 dollars which you don't have
- Dave: I don't know if Dave is a joke or actually appears in the game because I didn't make it that long

None of these enemies offer any particularly interesting mechanical interaction since they either instakill you on contact or make surviving particularly long impossible - 700 dollars is an insane penalty for doing nothing except not spotting a mimic in time and this will completely ruin your run. If the game killed you quickly after a full sanity break, fail states might approach a level of fear, but such as it is, it seems that the only thing that changes is the screen freaks out while you wander around waiting to get instakilled.
